gen-mystery-quest-fs-epilogue: Epilogue draws curvy, wire-thin letters with stubby ascender tips. Mystery Quest, bookish and a bit nostalgic, opens its curved strokes like jaws and tucks compact ascenders over tall lowercase, so the text beneath feels like a lighter, smoother thread.
gen-mystery-quest-fs-fira-sans: Wistful display letters meet a smooth, wire-drawn text face. Mystery Quest is best at nostalgic character with its open-jawed curves, and Fira Sans does its own job with a large x-height and no thick-thin shifts.
gen-mystery-quest-fs-merriweather-sans: Merriweather Sans reads sturdy and large, its tall lowercase and clearly open e making each word easy to take in. Then Mystery Quest adds a bookish, nostalgic note above it, with open-jawed curves and compact ascenders.
gen-gf-funnel-display-work-sans: Commanding spaghetti-like strokes give Funnel Display a loud, expressive voice, all in one width with c tips held well apart. Work Sans follows in a modern, contemporary tone, and its high mean line means you can size it a touch generously.
gen-gf-goldman-general-sans: Goldman spreads its bold letters wide, with a big lowercase and round forms like open parentheses. General Sans answers with a ruler-straight, steady line.
gen-gf-grandstander-fs-public-sans: Poured-ink lettering with a cheerful swagger leads here, as Grandstander holds every letter open at a single width. Public Sans then supplies a hefty, trustworthy plain sans body.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-suwannaphum: Bold, modern letters in New Title lock together like links in a fine chain, with tall lowercase beside the capitals. Suwannaphum feels dignified and editorial next to it, its open c and high x-height like squared-off woodblock type.
gen-dafont-dogica-manrope: Manrope keeps one steady pen width, with bright open mouths on every curve. Dogica is heavy and commanding, widely tracked with lowercase near capital height, and Manrope is the approachable, clean voice for text.
gen-orbitron-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Precise and minimal, Orbitron spreads wide letters with big, readable eyes on every e, which is what it does best. Be Vietnam Pro handles the text with strokes like a bent steel rod and curve endings that stay apart.
gen-orbitron-fs-merriweather-sans: Merriweather Sans brings sturdy, tall lowercase letters. Orbitron spaces its minimal, precise forms far apart with open apertures, and the pair's strongest quality is that wide, spread-out lettering against the compact sans-serif text.
